title: Meet type-tune! 🦀 Give Your TypeScript Types a Better Home! 😸
why_read: A small, focused CLI tool addressing a real pain point in large TypeScript codebases, locating and relocating shared type definitions.
analysis: type-tune is a Rust-based command-line tool that scans a TypeScript codebase to find types that are used across multiple files but poorly organized, then helps move them to better locations. This addresses a genuine maintenance problem distinct from existing tools like Knip, which find unused code rather than misplaced-but-used code. The scan-review-move-validate workflow is a sensible, low-risk approach to a tedious refactoring task that many TypeScript teams deal with manually. It's a niche but practically useful developer tool, though its value depends on how well it handles edge cases like circular dependencies or complex generic types.
